name: diag_scratch_authorized_cleanup_01
command:
import os,json,stat,hashlib,datetime,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('logs/review/diag_scratch_authorized_inventory_01/manifest.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='d83cff6e924d089ba941ed7195ed80f65bead2b98c0d89c8454333b454734dd8'
manifest=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert manifest['deletion_performed'] is False and not manifest['protected_matches']
assert str(p) in Path('STATUS.md').read_text()
base=Path('/scratch/e1583364/cvpr2027')
kept=[base/'smoke_e2e'/run/job/'checkpoint/actor/model_world_size_1_rank_0.pt' for run,job in [('smoke_e2e_T0_02','707612.hopper-m-02'),('smoke_e2e_T3_01','707642.hopper-m-02')]]
kept_meta={str(f):(f.stat().st_ino,f.stat().st_size,f.stat().st_mtime_ns) for f in kept}
def fs():
 s=os.statvfs(base)
 return {'reported_total_bytes':s.f_blocks*s.f_frsize,'reported_used_bytes':(s.f_blocks-s.f_bfree)*s.f_frsize,'reported_available_bytes':s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize,'filesystem_files_total':s.f_files,'filesystem_files_used':s.f_files-s.f_ffree,'filesystem_files_available':s.f_favail,'file_limit_scope':'filesystem-reported counts; account-specific inode quota not independently established'}
before=fs();deleted=[];skipped=[]
# Free large authorized B files first; the immutable list cannot grow.
for row in sorted(manifest['files'],key=lambda r:(r['category']!='B',r['path'])):
 f=Path(row['path'])
 assert f.is_relative_to(base) and row['category'] in ('A','B')
 try: s=f.lstat()
 except FileNotFoundError: skipped.append({'path':str(f),'reason':'already_absent'});continue
 current=(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_uid)
 expected=(row['device'],row['inode'],row['bytes'],row['mtime_ns'],row['uid'])
 if current!=expected or not stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode) or s.st_uid!=os.getuid():
  skipped.append({'path':str(f),'reason':'changed_since_inventory'});continue
 if row['category']=='B':
  assert f.suffix=='.pt' and f.name!='model_world_size_1_rank_0.pt' or f.parent.name=='critic'
 else: assert any(f.is_relative_to(base/'cache'/name) for name in ('pip','torch_extensions','triton','pycache'))
 f.unlink()
 deleted.append(row)
after=fs()
assert kept_meta=={str(f):(f.stat().st_ino,f.stat().st_size,f.stat().st_mtime_ns) for f in kept}
report={'authority':'43bc49c5','inventory':{'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'before':before,'after':after,'deleted_files':len(deleted),'deleted_logical_bytes':sum(r['bytes'] for r in deleted),'deleted_allocated_bytes':sum(r['allocated_bytes'] for r in deleted),'available_bytes_change':after['reported_available_bytes']-before['reported_available_bytes'],'skipped':skipped,'last_actor_models_retained':list(kept_meta),'preserved_data_and_results':True}
out=Path('logs/review/diag_scratch_authorized_cleanup_01');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
(out/'report.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
Path('STATUS.md').open('a').write('\n删除完成（'+datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()+'）：仅按上述固定A/B清单逐文件核对inode/mtime/大小/所有者后删除。删除'+str(report['deleted_files'])+'个文件，原分配字节'+str(report['deleted_allocated_bytes'])+'；df/statvfs可用容量从'+str(before['reported_available_bytes'])+'变为'+str(after['reported_available_bytes'])+'字节。变动/不存在跳过'+str(len(skipped))+'项。两份最后actor模型原inode/size/mtime保留；HF基础模型、环境、世界对、视角表、结果与日志未删。文件数/容量原始快照及范围见logs/review/diag_scratch_authorized_cleanup_01/report.json。\n')
print(json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
for command in (['df','-h',str(base)],['df','-i',str(base)]):
 subprocess.run(command,check=True,timeout=15)
